preconditions.description: The input string must be exactly 5 characters long, formatted as 'HH:MM'.
The input string must contain a colon at the second position.
The hours and minutes parts of the input string must be numeric.
The hour part of the input must be between 0 and 23, inclusive.
The minute part of the input must be between 0 and 59, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The result must be a non-negative integer representing the number of minutes till the next bus.
